description: This file defines an API client for interacting with a backend service, including HTTP request methods (GET and POST), error handling with custom exceptions, and environment configuration integration. It also includes an ApiException class and a typedef for token retrieval, intended for use within a Flutter app.

classes.name: ApiException
classes.description: Custom exception class for API errors, carrying HTTP status, message, URI, and cause details.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A client class for performing HTTP requests with support for default headers, authorization tokens, and automatic response handling.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs a GET request to a specified path with optional query parameters and headers.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs a POST request with a JSON body to a specified path, with optional headers and query parameters.

methods.name: _buildUri
methods.description: Constructs and returns a full URI from base URL, path, and query parameters.

methods.name: _buildHeaders
methods.description: Combines default headers, optional headers, and adds authorization if a token getter is provided.

methods.name: _handleResponse
methods.description: Processes the HTTP response, decoding JSON when appropriate, and throws ApiException on errors.

methods.name: _safePreview
methods.description: Returns a truncated preview of a string, used for logging request bodies.
